rules.statement: A proctor who accepted a bribe to unfairly secure a lease for an applicant was guilty of gross misconduct involving deceit.
rules.supporting_quote: He is proved to have deceived the Court, and I have no doubt the trustee, and possibly the other members of the committee, and in the matter of his attitude towards Mr. Martin's tender to have acted in flagrant disregard of the very interests he was there to protect.
